name: Survey tile in Cetus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Cetus, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 5 visits over 31 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 31 hours starting 2025-07-03, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
